title: PolySpeech-100: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Speech Understanding Across 100+ Languages and Dialects

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing speech comprehension accuracy on a multiple-choice task across three distinct linguistic groups: high-resource languages, regional dialects (e.g., Chinese and Arabic dialects), and low-resource (long-tail) languages to identify performance disparities.

Analyzing confusion matrices and option selection distributions to detect whether models exhibit a systemic preference for specific multiple-choice options (e.g., disproportionately predicting Option B) regardless of the ground truth or prompt suffixes.
